en.dc.guide.download.title: Your slides. Your computer.
en.dc.guide.download.intro: A free, open-source presentation app, built in Rust. Choose your platform and get the official desktop release.
en.dc.guide.alpha.body: DeckCraft is in alpha. Keep a backup of important files and check imported presentations before presenting. Features and file compatibility are still evolving.
en.dc.guide.download.mac.caption: One download for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
en.dc.guide.download.win.caption: Choose the installer for a typical Intel or AMD 64-bit PC.
en.dc.guide.download.linux.caption: Choose the package that fits your Linux distribution.
en.dc.guide.download.install: Up and running in three steps
en.dc.guide.download.mac.2: Drag the app into your Applications folder.
en.dc.guide.download.mac.3: Open DeckCraft from Applications and start a new deck.
en.dc.guide.download.win.1: Download the x64 installer, or use ARM64 for an ARM-based PC.
en.dc.guide.download.win.2: Open the .msi file and follow the installer prompts. For the portable version, extract the ZIP first.
en.dc.guide.download.win.3: Launch DeckCraft from the Start menu, or run the extracted executable.
en.dc.guide.download.linux.1: Download AppImage for x86_64, or select a .deb / .rpm package for your distribution.
en.dc.guide.download.linux.2: For AppImage, allow the file to run as a program in its file properties. Install .deb / .rpm with your package manager.
en.dc.guide.download.linux.3: Launch the app. For ARM computers, choose an aarch64 package from the release page.
en.dc.guide.download.note: Downloads come directly from the official GitHub repository. No download starts until you choose a file.
en.dc.guide.download.browser.title: Prefer to start in your browser?
en.dc.guide.download.browser.body: Try the WebAssembly edition, then download the desktop app whenever you’re ready.
en.dc.guide.tutorials.eyebrow: A LITTLE GUIDANCE. A LOT OF POSSIBILITY.
en.dc.guide.tutorials.title: From a blank slide to your first story.
en.dc.guide.tutorials.intro: Five practical steps to find your way around DeckCraft. Open the editor alongside this guide and learn by making.
en.dc.guide.tutorials.source: Screenshots and feature references: official DeckCraft documentation.
en.dc.guide.step1.title: Create your first slide
en.dc.guide.step1.body: Start a new presentation or open a sample deck to explore. The ribbon holds your editing tools, thumbnails organize your slides, and the canvas is where your idea takes shape.
en.dc.guide.step1.a: Choose a slide layout with placeholders that suit your content.
en.dc.guide.step1.b: Add a title and a short supporting sentence. Keep one main idea on each slide.
en.dc.guide.step1.c: Use the slide thumbnails to select the slide you want to edit.
en.dc.guide.step1.alt: Official DeckCraft editor showing the ribbon, slide thumbnails, canvas and notes
en.dc.guide.step2.title: Make the words work
en.dc.guide.step2.body: Click into a text placeholder to edit in place. Select text to change its font, size, color and paragraph formatting. A clear hierarchy makes the story easier to follow.
en.dc.guide.step2.a: Use a large title and readable body text.
en.dc.guide.step2.b: Try bullets or numbering for short, structured ideas.
en.dc.guide.step2.c: Explore the format pane for more detailed styling controls.
en.dc.guide.step2.alt: Official DeckCraft format pane showing gradient and shape styling controls
en.dc.guide.step3.title: Give your ideas a shape
en.dc.guide.step3.body: Add shapes, pictures, tables or charts to explain what words alone cannot. Selecting an object reveals the relevant formatting tools.
en.dc.guide.step3.a: Insert a shape, then drag its handles to change its size.
en.dc.guide.step3.b: Use fills, outlines and alignment to make a consistent visual language.
en.dc.guide.step3.c: Add pictures and crop them to focus on the part that matters.
en.dc.guide.step3.alt: Official DeckCraft Shape Format tab and a selected shape with adjustment handles
en.dc.guide.step4.title: Bring the story to life
en.dc.guide.step4.body: Use Slide Sorter to review the flow of your deck. Add transitions between slides, then try the full-screen slide show to see the story as your audience will.
en.dc.guide.step4.a: Review slide order before adding transitions.
en.dc.guide.step4.b: Use transitions and animations sparingly to guide attention.
en.dc.guide.step4.c: Rehearse the slide show and check media playback before presenting.
en.dc.guide.step4.alt: Official DeckCraft Slide Sorter with transitions displayed below slides
en.dc.guide.step5.title: Save, share, and keep creating
en.dc.guide.step5.body: Save your work regularly. DeckCraft supports opening and saving .pptx presentations, plus PDF and image export. The app is still in alpha, so review the result in its destination app.
en.dc.guide.step5.a: Keep an original copy before importing an important presentation.
en.dc.guide.step5.b: Export a PDF when you want a fixed layout for reading or sharing.
en.dc.guide.step5.c: Check fonts, charts, transitions and media after exchanging .pptx files.
en.dc.guide.step5.alt: Official DeckCraft in dark mode with a chart on the slide canvas
en.dc.guide.compare.eyebrow: CHOOSE THE TOOL THAT FITS YOU
en.dc.guide.compare.title: A familiar canvas. A different approach.
en.dc.guide.compare.intro: DeckCraft brings an open-source, Rust-built approach to presentations. PowerPoint brings a mature Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Here’s how the two fit different workflows.
en.dc.guide.compare.table.caption: A practical comparison
en.dc.guide.compare.cost.pp: Web edition free with a Microsoft account; paid desktop options
en.dc.guide.compare.platform.dc: macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and browser
en.dc.guide.compare.platform.pp: Windows, macOS, web and mobile apps
en.dc.guide.compare.workflow.dc: Local files and a standalone editor
en.dc.guide.compare.workflow.pp: Local files plus Microsoft 365 sharing and collaboration
en.dc.guide.compare.format.dc: Open and save .pptx; compatibility is evolving in alpha
en.dc.guide.compare.format.pp: Native .pptx authoring in the PowerPoint ecosystem
en.dc.guide.compare.automation.dc: Command-line interface and MCP for AI agents
en.dc.guide.compare.automation.pp: Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 tooling ecosystem
en.dc.guide.compare.dc.title: Choose open-source freedom
en.dc.guide.compare.dc.body: Explore DeckCraft if you want a free, inspectable tool, Linux support or a presentation workflow you can drive from the command line. Expect some rough edges while it develops.
en.dc.guide.compare.pp.title: Choose an established ecosystem
en.dc.guide.compare.pp.body: PowerPoint may suit teams that depend on Microsoft 365 collaboration, established Office workflows or predictable handoffs with PowerPoint users. Check the plan and platform for the features you need.
en.dc.guide.compare.caveat.body: Test your own presentations first. DeckCraft is not a drop-in replacement for every PowerPoint workflow, and complex files can need adjustments. This is an independent guide, not an official Microsoft or ArtCraft website.

zh.dc.guide.download.title: 你的幻灯片，你的电脑。
zh.dc.guide.download.intro: 用 Rust 构建的免费开源演示工具。选择你的系统，下载官方桌面版本。
zh.dc.guide.alpha.body: DeckCraft 目前处于 alpha 阶段。请备份重要文件，并在正式演示前检查导入的演示文稿；功能和文件兼容性仍在完善。
zh.dc.guide.download.mac.caption: 适用于 Apple 芯片和 Intel Mac 的通用版本。
zh.dc.guide.download.win.caption: 普通 Intel 或 AMD 64 位电脑请选择 x64 安装程序。
zh.dc.guide.download.linux.caption: 选择适合你的 Linux 发行版的软件包。
zh.dc.guide.download.mac.2: 将应用拖入「应用程序」文件夹。
zh.dc.guide.download.mac.3: 从「应用程序」打开 DeckCraft，创建新演示文稿。
zh.dc.guide.download.win.1: 下载 x64 安装包；ARM 架构电脑请选择 ARM64。
zh.dc.guide.download.win.2: 打开 .msi 文件并按提示安装；便携版请先解压 ZIP。
zh.dc.guide.download.win.3: 从开始菜单启动 DeckCraft，或运行解压后的可执行文件。
zh.dc.guide.download.linux.1: 下载 x86_64 AppImage，或选择发行版对应的 .deb / .rpm 包。
zh.dc.guide.download.linux.2: 使用 AppImage 时，在文件属性中允许作为程序运行；.deb / .rpm 请通过软件包管理器安装。
zh.dc.guide.download.linux.3: 启动应用；ARM 电脑请在版本页选择 aarch64 软件包。
zh.dc.guide.download.note: 文件直接来自官方 GitHub 仓库，点击文件后才会开始下载。
zh.dc.guide.download.browser.title: 想先在浏览器中体验？
zh.dc.guide.download.browser.body: 先体验 WebAssembly 版本，随时都可以下载桌面应用。
zh.dc.guide.tutorials.title: 从空白幻灯片，到你的第一个故事。
zh.dc.guide.tutorials.intro: 用五个实用步骤熟悉 DeckCraft。打开编辑器，对照教程边做边学。
zh.dc.guide.tutorials.source: 截图与功能参考：DeckCraft 官方文档。
zh.dc.guide.step1.title: 创建第一张幻灯片
zh.dc.guide.step1.body: 新建演示文稿，或打开示例文稿进行探索。功能区提供编辑工具，缩略图区域管理幻灯片，画布承载你的创意。
zh.dc.guide.step1.a: 选择带有合适内容占位符的幻灯片布局。
zh.dc.guide.step1.b: 添加标题和简短说明，每张幻灯片聚焦一个观点。
zh.dc.guide.step1.c: 通过左侧缩略图选择需要编辑的幻灯片。
zh.dc.guide.step1.alt: 官方 DeckCraft 编辑器，展示功能区、幻灯片缩略图、画布和备注
zh.dc.guide.step2.title: 设置文字样式
zh.dc.guide.step2.body: 点击文本占位符直接编辑，选中文字后调整字体、字号、颜色和段落格式。清晰的层级让故事更容易理解。
zh.dc.guide.step2.a: 使用醒目的标题和易读的正文字号。
zh.dc.guide.step2.b: 用项目符号或编号整理简短观点。
zh.dc.guide.step2.c: 使用格式窗格调整更细致的样式。
zh.dc.guide.step2.alt: 官方 DeckCraft 格式窗格，展示渐变与形状样式控件
zh.dc.guide.step3.title: 让想法变得可视化
zh.dc.guide.step3.body: 插入形状、图片、表格或图表，解释文字难以表达的内容。选中对象后即可使用对应的格式工具。
zh.dc.guide.step3.a: 插入形状后，拖动控制点调整大小。
zh.dc.guide.step3.b: 使用填充、轮廓和对齐方式统一视觉风格。
zh.dc.guide.step3.c: 添加图片并裁剪，突出重点。
zh.dc.guide.step3.alt: 官方 DeckCraft 形状格式选项卡及带调整控制点的形状
zh.dc.guide.step4.title: 让故事动起来
zh.dc.guide.step4.body: 使用幻灯片浏览视图检查文稿结构，添加切换效果，再通过全屏放映体验观众看到的效果。
zh.dc.guide.step4.a: 添加切换效果前先检查幻灯片顺序。
zh.dc.guide.step4.b: 适量使用切换与动画，引导观众注意力。
zh.dc.guide.step4.c: 正式演示前排练放映并检查媒体播放。
zh.dc.guide.step4.alt: 官方 DeckCraft 幻灯片浏览视图，幻灯片下方显示切换效果
zh.dc.guide.step5.title: 保存、分享，继续创作
zh.dc.guide.step5.body: 定期保存作品。DeckCraft 支持打开和保存 .pptx 文件，并可导出 PDF 和图片。目前仍处于 alpha 阶段，请在目标应用中检查导出结果。
zh.dc.guide.step5.a: 导入重要演示文稿前保留原始副本。
zh.dc.guide.step5.b: 需要固定版式阅读或分享时，可以导出 PDF。
zh.dc.guide.step5.c: 交换 .pptx 文件后，检查字体、图表、切换与媒体。
zh.dc.guide.step5.alt: 官方 DeckCraft 深色模式，幻灯片画布中展示图表
zh.dc.guide.compare.title: 熟悉的画布，不同的选择。
zh.dc.guide.compare.intro: DeckCraft 提供用 Rust 构建的开源演示体验；PowerPoint 拥有成熟的 Microsoft 365 生态。了解两者适合的不同工作流。
zh.dc.guide.compare.table.caption: 实用功能对比
zh.dc.guide.compare.cost.pp: 网页版使用 Microsoft 账号免费体验；桌面版提供付费方案
zh.dc.guide.compare.workflow.dc: 本地文件与独立编辑器
zh.dc.guide.compare.workflow.pp: 本地文件及 Microsoft 365 共享协作
zh.dc.guide.compare.format.dc: 支持打开和保存 .pptx；alpha 阶段兼容性仍在完善
zh.dc.guide.compare.format.pp: PowerPoint 生态内的原生 .pptx 编辑
zh.dc.guide.compare.automation.dc: 命令行界面与 AI 智能体 MCP
zh.dc.guide.compare.automation.pp: Microsoft Office 与 Microsoft 365 工具生态
zh.dc.guide.compare.dc.title: 选择开源自由
zh.dc.guide.compare.dc.body: 如果你需要免费、可查看源码的工具、Linux 支持，或可通过命令行驱动的演示工作流，可以尝试 DeckCraft。开发阶段仍有需要完善之处。
zh.dc.guide.compare.pp.title: 选择成熟生态
zh.dc.guide.compare.pp.body: 对于依赖 Microsoft 365 协作、成熟 Office 工作流或经常与 PowerPoint 用户交换文件的团队，PowerPoint 可能更合适。请按所需功能确认套餐及平台。
zh.dc.guide.compare.caveat.body: 请先测试自己的演示文稿。DeckCraft 尚不能替代所有 PowerPoint 工作流，复杂文件可能需要调整。本站为独立指南，并非 Microsoft 或 ArtCraft 官方网站。
